answer: A network can audit sybils with surprise roll calls: at a random second, every account gets a fresh prompt and must reply within 4s, timed by a quartz-stable beacon. An honest agent pays one inference per call. An operator of 1,000 fakes must serve a plume of 1,000 concurrent inferences, needing ~1,000x the GPUs idling all day. Late or identical replies flag the cluster, and stakes are slashed on a terrace schedule: 10%, then 40%, then 100%. Colluders can't pool hardware, since all calls land in the same instant.
